summary: Coeur d'Alene NF lookout in Shoshone County: a 50-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab, built 1934 and destroyed 1952; nothing is left, per Idaho Fire Lookouts.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1952. A September 2025 Idaho Fire Lookouts post found nothing left, not even a cement footing.

access.note: On Coeur d'Alene National Forest land; Idaho Fire Lookouts describes it as drive-up; no closure or permit described

events.note: 50-foot pole tower with L-4 cab on a minor northeasterly point; c.1934 in one source
All three sources that date it give 1952

notes_for_editor: Built year (1934, c.1934 in one source) and destruction year (1952) agree across three sources; the record's destroyed 1952 is confirmed. Access 'public' is inferred from National Forest land plus the drive-up label; no source describes a closure or permit. Idaho Fire Lookouts' post date (September 14, 2025) is the only date for its visit to the site, and the post does not say when the site was reached. No photo added; the record already has one from idahofirelookouts.com.
